summary: Audit valid unborn Git repositories without hiding corrupt HEAD metadata

delivery.outcome: A fleet audit represents a valid unborn checkout explicitly and continues without weakening corruption failures
nonGoals: No commits or mutations in audited repositories
No suppression of malformed or missing Git metadata

architecture.decision: Use porcelain v2 branch.oid initial as the only proof that an unresolved HEAD is a valid unborn repository
dataChanges: Finding evidence head is nullable for an unborn checkout
architecture.rollback: Revert before merge; the prior checker remains fail-closed on unborn repositories

validation.evidence: A valid initial repository is audited without a lifecycle finding
Two empty checkouts of one remote identity produce one duplicate finding with null head

commands: all commands from the Linux CI test job
validation.evidence: Focused and complete contracts preserve all existing lifecycle behavior
Provider failure is fail-closed without fallback and independent LLM review binds the exact head
